FORM._README: FORM equipment, keyed by trigger CATEGORY:VARIABLE. Bit trigger = one sequence per handshake (request ON, confirm ON, request OFF, confirm OFF). Word trigger (type word, the default for I_W_) = one sequence per value change. confirm/ack are optional. Red in the Sequence tab = ACK not in ack_ok, no confirm, or the handshake was cut short. match = text in the log element name, e.g. GM2_DEGASLOADER_01_01. Generate a starting block from the EIF source with form_extract.py, then add ALM_INFO alarm triggers and timer BRs by hand.
